## Which checks run?

Illustrative single-path changes evaluated by [the classifier](../../scripts/ci/changes.mjs). Mixed changes take the union; unknown paths, empty diffs, unavailable history, and manual runs request the full set. Policy checks and CI Gate always run on PRs. “Prepare” selects the release path after merge; automatic preparation also depends on version policy. Manual preparation requests a candidate.

| Changed path | QA | Gems | UI | Prepare | Store inventory |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>docs/release-pipeline.md</code> | — | — | — | — | — |
| <code>fastlane/metadata/en-US/description.txt</code> | — | — | — | Yes | Yes |
| <code>fastlane/screenshots/processed/en-US/01_FullPreview.png</code> | — | — | — | Yes | Yes |
| <code>PicStrip/ContentView.swift</code> | Yes | — | Yes | Yes | — |
| <code>PicStripTests/ImageProcessorTests.swift</code> | Yes | — | — | Yes | — |
| <code>.github/workflows/pr.yml</code> | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| <code>unknown/new-file</code> | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### App Store Deploy (internal)

[Source](../../.github/workflows/app-store-deploy.yml) · [Actions](https://github.com/northcutted/picstrip/actions/workflows/app-store-deploy.yml)

Triggers (cron expressions use UTC):

```json
{
  "create": null,
  "release": {
    "types": [
      "published"
    ]
  },
  "workflow_dispatch": {}
}
```

Concurrency: <code>{"group":"app-store-deploy-${{ github.ref }}","cancel-in-progress":false}</code>. Default token permissions: <code>{"contents":"read"}</code>.

| Manual input | Type | Required | Default | Description / choices |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>release_tag</code> | <code>string</code> | Yes | — | Immutable release tag; run on its release or protected deployment tag |
| <code>submit</code> | <code>boolean</code> | No | <code>true</code> | Request production approval after staging |
| <code>metadata_commit</code> | <code>string</code> | No | <code>"" (blank)</code> | Recovery only; exact reviewed metadata commit |

| Job | Needs | Execution | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>resolve</code> | — | <code>ubuntu-24.04</code>; 5 min | <code>github.event_name != 'create' &#124;&#124; (github.event.ref_type == 'tag' &amp;&amp; contains(github.ref_name, '-deploy-'))</code> |
| <code>deploy</code> | <code>resolve</code> | [deploy.yml](https://github.com/northcutted/ios-release-workflows/blob/060db3e9c163ece5eb2836ac06344828b728bfe8/.github/workflows/deploy.yml) | — |

### Release Maintenance

[Source](../../.github/workflows/observe.yml) · [Actions](https://github.com/northcutted/picstrip/actions/workflows/observe.yml)

Triggers (cron expressions use UTC):

```json
{
  "schedule": [
    {
      "cron": "17 */6 * * *"
    }
  ],
  "workflow_dispatch": {}
}
```

Concurrency: <code>{"group":"app-store-observe","cancel-in-progress":false}</code>. Default token permissions: <code>{"contents":"read"}</code>.

| Manual input | Type | Required | Default | Description / choices |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>action</code> | <code>choice</code> | No | <code>App Store status</code> | Maintenance action<br><code>App Store status</code>, <code>Inspect release controls</code> |

| Job | Needs | Execution | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>observe</code> | — | [observe.yml](https://github.com/northcutted/ios-release-workflows/blob/060db3e9c163ece5eb2836ac06344828b728bfe8/.github/workflows/observe.yml) | <code>vars.RELEASE_DISTRIBUTION_ENABLED == 'true' &amp;&amp; (github.event_name == 'schedule' &#124;&#124; inputs.action == 'App Store status')</code> |
| <code>inspect</code> | — | <code>ubuntu-24.04</code>; 5 min<br>Environment: <code>release-publishing</code> | <code>github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &amp;&amp; github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; inputs.action == 'Inspect release controls'</code> |

### PR Checks

[Source](../../.github/workflows/pr.yml) · [Actions](https://github.com/northcutted/picstrip/actions/workflows/pr.yml)

Triggers (cron expressions use UTC):

```json
{
  "pull_request": {
    "branches": [
      "main"
    ],
    "types": [
      "opened",
      "synchronize",
      "reopened",
      "ready_for_review"
    ]
  },
  "workflow_dispatch": {}
}
```

Concurrency: <code>{"group":"pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number &#124;&#124; github.ref }}","cancel-in-progress":true}</code>. Default token permissions: <code>{"contents":"read"}</code>.

| Manual input | Type | Required | Default | Description / choices |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>test_workers</code> | <code>choice</code> | No | <code>1</code> | Benchmark only; production remains serial until five-run acceptance<br><code>1</code>, <code>2</code> |

| Job | Needs | Execution | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>changes</code><br>Select required checks | — | <code>ubuntu-24.04</code>; 5 min | — |
| <code>policy</code><br>Workflow policy and release regression tests | <code>changes</code> | <code>ubuntu-24.04</code>; 30 min | — |
| <code>qa</code> | <code>changes</code> | [ci.yml](https://github.com/northcutted/ios-release-workflows/blob/060db3e9c163ece5eb2836ac06344828b728bfe8/.github/workflows/ci.yml) | <code>needs.changes.outputs.qa == 'true'</code> |
| <code>gems-macos</code><br>Locked gems on macOS | <code>changes</code> | <code>xcode-27</code>; 30 min | <code>needs.changes.outputs.gems == 'true'</code> |
| <code>screenshots</code><br>UI and screenshot smoke test | <code>changes</code> | <code>xcode-27</code>; 60 min | <code>needs.changes.outputs.screenshots == 'true'</code> |
| <code>gate</code><br>CI Gate | <code>changes</code>, <code>policy</code>, <code>qa</code>, <code>gems-macos</code>, <code>screenshots</code> | <code>ubuntu-24.04</code>; 30 min | <code>always()</code> |
